verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms docs.openclaw.ai/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a product summary, and a second llms.txt exists at openclaw.ai. The docs pages are served as raw Markdown (.md URLs throughout), giving agents directly consumable, agent-oriented documentation. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents successfully using these docs, and evidence of an expanded llms-full.txt variant.
